sentence: This project tests how a mindfulness-based intervention affects mood lability in early adolescents at high risk for developing mood disorders.
This project studies the structure of a phosphatase and how mutations in it cause disease.
This project studies how RNA fragments help control genes in human neurons during Alzheimer’s Disease.
This project cleans, stores and summarizes data from other projects and shares the processed data in public databases.
This project uses a high throughput screening assay to find inhibitors of the persistent hepatitis B genome in infected patients.
This project studies how circadian clock factors and feeding help pancreatic islet cells and liver cells develop specialized functions.
This project builds methods to study psychiatric genetics data from people of many geographic origins, using electronic health records.
This project builds vectors derived from a virus to treat the bleeding disorder hemophilia with gene therapy more safely.
This project studies how typhoidal Salmonella survives and multiplies in human macrophages and in humanized mice.
This project studies how immune suppression helps basal cell tumors resist treatment and tests whether blocking a protein boosts the immune response.
This project studies how bacteria and yeast cells adapt to changes in their environment.
This project builds an automated system that measures electrical activity and muscle contractions of heart cells made from stem cells to test drug responses.
This project works to make radiotherapy more effective against tumors while causing less harm to normal tissues.
This project uses mass spectrometry to measure the molecules that carry signals between brain cells in addiction.
This project tries to find molecular and circuit targets that change how the brain adapts during a juvenile critical period.
This project builds a framework to find shared mechanisms among genes that raise risk for intellectual and developmental disabilities.
This project studies how fungi living on the skin contribute to atopic dermatitis and how they interact with bacteria and skin cells.
This project builds shared research facilities to support work on medical devices and sensors.
This project develops cancer treatments that are more effective and less toxic, from early lab work to early clinical trials.
This project uses stem cells made from body cells to study how high blood sugar in pregnant mothers leads to congenital heart disease.
